connections.notes: 3A sits at the southern end of the Great Northern Hall (4). There is a clear open passage/archway connecting northward from 3A into room 4's large gridded hall.
3B is adjacent to 3A and connected via stairs — parallel lines visible on the map indicate a stairway linking these two parts of the Arched Stairwell Junction.
The Northern Corridor (9) connects to 3A via an open passage running westward from 3A into the corridor.
J3 (Trapped Fork) appears connected to 3A via a passage visible to the south/southwest of 3A, with an open corridor link between them.

not_connected.reason: Room 2 (Western Burial Tunnels) is located far to the southwest of 3A with no direct passage between them; multiple walls and corridors separate them.
3C is part of the Arched Stairwell Junction but does not share a direct opening with 3A; 3B intervenes between them with no visible direct passage from 3A to 3C.
4A (Great Bronze Doors) is located to the north/northeast of 3A with solid walls between them; no visible passage directly connects 3A to 4A.
Room 7 (Western Corridor) is to the west of 3A but separated by walls with no visible direct opening between 3A and room 7.
J1 (Burial Tunnel Branch) is located well to the west/southwest of 3A with no direct passage; walls and intervening corridors block any direct connection.
J2 (Western Corridor Fork) is to the west of 3A separated by walls and other rooms; no visible direct passage connects them.
